problem.title: Create Grid With Exactly One Path

approaches.title: Construct a grid with a single open route
approaches.summary: Make the first row entirely open and each remaining row blocked except for its final cell, creating exactly one path through the grid.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Build the first row with open cells, then use a loop to construct each remaining row with only its final cell open.

revisions.commitBody:
- simplify string building with format! macro
- remove need for manual loop with .resize
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Keep the same grid construction strategy, but build the repeated row with `format!` and fill the grid using `resize`.
